result.summary: Adds unit test coverage for FlatFilePos serialization and file seeking around 32-bit integer boundaries (2 GiB, 4 GiB, and UINT64_MAX). This verifies that flatfile positioning preserves 64-bit offsets and does not truncate to 32 bits.
result.problem: PR #36669 updated flatfile positions to 64 bits, but test coverage only exercised small offsets. An accidental cast or truncation to uint32_t when seeking or serializing FlatFilePos would pass existing test suites unnoticed.
evidence: The PR description demonstrates that testing against code prior to #36669, or intentionally casting FlatFileSeq::Open offset to uint32_t, fails the new test while passing all existing flatfile tests.
Follows up merged PR #36669 ('refactor: store positions as a 64 bits integer in flatfiles').
result.card: Adds unit tests for FlatFilePos 64-bit boundary conditions, checking serialization and seeking across 2 GiB and 4 GiB offsets. Existing flatfile tests only used small offsets and would not catch 32-bit truncation regressions introduced after PR #36669 expanded flatfile positions to 64 bits. The author confirmed that artificially casting FlatFileSeq::Open offsets to uint32_t fails these new tests while passing existing tests.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests; any failure would cause test suite failures without affecting node runtime behavior.
